meta.name: debug
meta.description: Investigate a failure, regression or incorrect result in an integration or application, even before it can be reproduced. Use for diagnosis and repair; follow incident authority for live mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查清集成或应用里说不清的故障、回归与错误结果,找到根因并修好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果联调或线上出现故障、回归或结果异常,需要找出根因并修复。
copy.tagline_en: Find and fix failures, regressions or wrong results you can't yet reproduce.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a failure, regression or odd result needs root-cause digging and repair.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调查集成或应用里的故障、回归或错误结果，即使问题还无法复现也照样开工；侧重诊断与修复，线上止血则听从事故处理权限。
howto.when: 当你需要诊断和修复故障、回归或错误结果时接管，即使尚无法复现；线上止血按事故处理权限走。

say.text: 帮我排查这个集成的报错，现在还没法复现
say.note: 进入诊断流程，保留未知项

say.text: 这个应用返回的结果不对，查原因并给修复方案
say.note: 按调试方法做诊断与修复

say.text: 我这边有个回归问题，先帮我定位根因
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: Claude investigates failures, regressions or incorrect results in an integration or application, even before they can be reproduced. Focus: diagnosis and repair; live mitigation follows incident authority.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a failure, regression or incorrect result diagnosed and repaired, even if it cannot yet be reproduced; live mitigation follows incident authority.

say_en.text: Help me debug this integration's error; I can't reproduce it yet
This app returns wrong results - find the cause and a fix
I have a regression; locate the root cause first
